pages.title: Cold Forging Basics
pages.text: Cold forging is the core crafting system of this mod. Instead of smelting metal in a furnace, you use a §4stone anvil§r and various tools to shape metal into useful items.$(br2)For a complete guide, read the §bCold Forge Manual§r (obtainable separately). This chapter covers the essentials.

pages.title: Step 1: Make Billets
pages.text: $(li)Craft a §4Granite Anvil§r or §4Limestone Anvil§r$(br)$(li)Combine natural metal block + water bucket = billet$(br)$(li)Each billet has random weight and quality$(br2)§4Tip:§r You can craft multiple times to get a higher weight billet.

pages.title: Step 2: Heat the Billet
pages.text: $(li)Craft and place a §4Fire Pit§r$(br)$(li)Add fuel (firewood, straw bale) to the fire pit$(br)$(li)Right-click the fire pit to ignite it$(br)$(li)Put the billet in the fire pit to heat$(br)$(li)Wait for it to become a §dsoftened billet§r$(br2)§cWARNING:§r Use wooden clamp to retrieve hot items!

pages.title: Step 3: Forge on Anvil
pages.text: Place the softened billet on the anvil, then:$(br2)$(li)§4Hammer§r (left-click): Forges billet into metal sheet$(br)$(li)§4Axe§r (right-click): Bends sheet into curve$(br)$(li)§4Axe§r (right-click): Bends curve into slot$(br)$(li)§4Chisel§r (left-click): Carves slot into knife$(br)$(li)§4Hammer§r (left-click): Forges curve into axe head$(br)$(li)§4Hammer§r (left-click): Forges slot into sword blade

pages.title: Step 4: Final Products
pages.text: From the basic forging process, you can create:$(br2)$(li)§cPrimitive Knife§r - from slot + chisel carving$(br)$(li)§cAxe Head§r - from curve + hammer forging$(br)$(li)§cSword Blade§r - from slot + hammer forging$(br)$(li)§cCopper:§r Slot → Ring → Hook → Pin (axe, progressive)$(br)$(li)§cSilver/Gold:§r Slot → Pin directly (no ring or hook stage)$(br)$(li)§cCopper Fishing Rod§r - copper ring + copper hook + line + stick$(br2)§4Tip:§r The §bCold Forge Manual§r has detailed recipes for all products.

pages.title: Billet Cooling
pages.text: Softened billets will eventually cool down:$(br2)$(li)§bWater Cooling:§r Drop in water to cool instantly$(br)$(li)§bNatural Cooling:§r Soft copper billets cool after a period of time in inventory$(br)$(li)§bGold/Silver:§r Do not cool naturally (only water cooling)$(br2)Once cooled, billets return to hard state and must be reheated.
